title: Manyam Puli
desc: Murugan, who is famous in his village for killing man-eating tigers and leopards, becomes a part of a conspiracy surrounding illegal drugs.

title: Simha
desc: Srimannarayana, a college professor who cannot tolerate injustice, meets Janaki when he saves her from goons. Soon his grandmother makes some revelations that take him back to his village.

title: Fun Time
desc: An energetic entertainment show aimed at families, featuring games, comedy, performances, and celebrity guests-designed to bring joy, laughter, and shared memories.
